abstract.p: Operational access determines whether emergency cooling services reach residents.

sec.title: Access constraints
sec.p: Cooling centers cannot protect residents who cannot reach them. Transit access, accessible hours, and multilingual outreach must be part of the operating plan.

sec.title: Scope
sec.p: A site opening is not evidence that every resident received protection. Operators must inspect access barriers rather than infer universal coverage.
